package_metadata.purpose: Concrete diagnostic questions for JavaScript AI review.

diagnostic_questions.question: Which runtime executes this file: browser, Node, Apps Script server, HtmlService browser code, bundled browser code, test runner, or build tool?
diagnostic_questions.why_it_matters: Every API assumption depends on the host runtime.
evidence_needed: HTML script tag or Apps Script manifest
good_answer_signs: Specific runtime named and supported by config/deployment evidence
red_flag_answer_signs: Uses document and fs in same unclassified module
